navbe-ai.title: Navbe
navbe-ai.description: AI agents lose context between runs and can't be scheduled like real work. I built an MCP-based workflow orchestrator: agents create and schedule recurring flows through MCP tools, with a FastAPI engine and a Next.js dashboard.

gemini-enterprise-sales-agent.title: Gemini Enterprise Sales Agent
gemini-enterprise-sales-agent.description: Reference sales agent for teams adopting Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Built with Google ADK: multi-agent with a price-objection sub-agent, deployed on Agent Engine with tracing; taught as a hands-on workshop.

small-llm-finetuning.title: Fine-tuning a Small LLM
small-llm-finetuning.description: Custom fine-tuning of small language models for domain-specific tasks, tuned for performance at a fraction of the compute.

Diagram.title: Multi-tenant AI sales agent architecture
Diagram.desc: Messaging channels feed a shared agent harness: an orchestrator agent with sales, scheduling and support sub-agents, LLM routing, context and memory, tools and skills, guardrails and observability. The harness connects to catalog, calendar and payments, and keeps each business isolated as a tenant.
Diagram.caption: One shared harness. Isolated configuration, knowledge and limits per business.
